If you remember Austin's twice-a-year bulk weeks, forget them. **Since January 2025, Austin Resource Recovery collects bulk items by appointment only**, and the city reports the switch saved money and cut illegal dumping. The new system is better if you know it exists, and a trap if you're still waiting for a postcard that no longer comes.

## The On-Demand Rules, Exactly

- **Schedule through the Austin Recycles app or 311 (512-974-2000).** Eligible customers are Austin Resource Recovery residential households, single-family homes through fourplexes.
- **Three bulk collections per calendar year, per address.** Brush, household hazardous waste, and textiles each have their own separate allowance.
- **The three-pile rule:** metal items, passenger tires, and non-metal items (furniture, carpet) in separate piles at the curb. Mixed piles get skipped.
- **Set out early on your scheduled day, before crews start their routes**, per your appointment confirmation.
- **The city's own guidance:** there are currently no recycling or reuse options for furniture collected through bulk pickup, so it goes to landfill. Austin Resource Recovery explicitly asks residents to rehome or donate usable furniture rather than using bulk collection. A reuse warehouse is in development.

## Where Booked Removal Fits

Three appointments a year is a budget, and burning one on a single couch is poor use of it. Renters in larger buildings aren't eligible at all. And the city's own landfill admission makes the donation question central: a couch that [passes condition standards](/blog/eco-friendly-living/can-couch-be-donated/) should never ride a bulk truck.

[Couch removal in Austin](/tx/austin/couch-removal/) starts at $90 with carry-out included, [same-day in most ZIPs when booked before 2PM local time](/book-online/), and [donation pickup](/tx/austin/donation-pickup/) routes good furniture to local partners first. Pricing by item is in the [cost guide](/blog/junk-removal/how-much-does-couch-removal-cost/).

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does Austin still have bulk collection weeks?

No. Fixed neighborhood bulk weeks ended in January 2025. Bulk pickup is now by appointment through the Austin Recycles app or 311, three per year per address.

### How many bulk pickups does Austin allow?

Three bulk collections per calendar year per address, with separate allowances for brush, household hazardous waste, and textiles.

### Does Austin recycle furniture from bulk pickup?

Not currently. The city states there are no reuse or recycling options for bulk-collected furniture and asks residents to donate usable items instead.

### What's the fastest way to remove a couch in Austin?

Booked removal without spending an annual appointment: [same-day across most of Austin](/tx/austin/couch-removal/) when booked before 2PM local time, carried from inside your home, donation routing first.
